name: compare_snapshots
description: Structured diff between two queries to the same endpoint with different parameters. Returns items that appeared, disappeared, or changed between the two snapshots. Use this to detect what changed between two time periods, regions, or filter criteria.

parameters.endpoint: string (required) — Sidecar API path to query twice

examples.description: Compare conflict events between two weeks
examples.call: compare_snapshots({ endpoint: "/api/acled-events", before_params: { date_from: "2026-04-01", date_to: "2026-04-07" }, after_params: { date_from: "2026-04-08", date_to: "2026-04-14" } })

examples.description: Compare earthquakes above different magnitude thresholds
examples.call: compare_snapshots({ endpoint: "/api/earthquakes", before_params: { min_magnitude: "4.0" }, after_params: { min_magnitude: "5.0" } })
